newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM officials to visit IPE, SIMEX for oil talks.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM officials to visit IPE, SIMEX for oil talks.

text.p: The architects of a Tokyo-based oil futures contract said on Monday they were set to begin informal consultations with London's International Petroleum Exchange (IPE) and its Asian counterpart, SIMEX.

The Tokyo Commodities Exchange (TOCOM) group, led by planning manager Mitsuhiro Onosato, will meet this week in London with IPE officials to discuss the viability of TOCOM's plan to launch either a crude oil or gasoline futures contract in April 1999, a TOCOM official said. That meeting will be followed by informal advisory talks in Singapore with key tacticians of the Singapore International Monetary Exchange's (SIMEX) crude oil and fuel oil futures contract, another source close to the talks said.
TOCOM officials said the trip might also be tailored to include a brief stop in Hong Kong, but they would not elaborate.
The Hong Kong Futures Exchange (HKFE) is scheduled to begin electronic trade of oil and other commodities with the New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) on June 12.
